# Context array（上下文阵列）

面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**本地五维记忆**插件，围绕一条硬规则构建：
**绝不重写被缓存的前缀**。动态内容一律追加在已缓存历史之后，静态内容只在拼装阶段注册。

当前仓库包含设计文档
[`dsh-context-array-v4.1.md`](dsh-context-array-v4.1.md) 里程碑 **M1**（观测 / 追加 / 静态存储）
与 **M2**（本地 embedding + 混合检索）的实现，以及 **M0-6 压缩接管机制**、**M1-4 双轨缓存指标**。
实测记录：[`docs/M1-RESULTS.md`](docs/M1-RESULTS.md)、[`docs/M2-RESULTS.md`](docs/M2-RESULTS.md)。

> **状态**：M1、M2、M3 已跑通并实测。**M0-6 压缩已接管并实装折叠**（`compactionMode: fold`）：
> 保留系统头、在轮次边界把较早区间换成一条 `compact-checkpoint` 摘要，金丝雀实测折了
> 13 个节点 / 6,855 token 且会话继续正常。**两个受控实验也把"前缀被改动打穿"这条风险排除了**：
> 该 `in-history` 路由上改提示词不会重写系统节点 0；运行期增删工具也不改声明块，`prefixHit` 恒 1。
> 真正会打断缓存的是**压缩折叠**本身——这是设计上已知并接受的一次性代价，折叠轮次在
> `events.jsonl` 里以 `history/replace` / `compaction/folded` 单独标记。
> **M3** 中央记忆管理员与异步队列已跑通：普通会话 `memory_propose` 入队，管理员
> `memory_queue_claim` → `memory_archive` 入库（本地 embedding），越权调用被服务端拒绝。
> M4（留言箱 + 多空间 UI）待开工。

## 缓存节省测算（真实日志）

221 个请求、81.5M 提示词 token，其中 99.76% 命中缓存。若无缓存、每请求全价重算：

| 命中价/未命中价 `r` | 计费输入等价值 | 相对无缓存节省 |
|---|---|---|
| 0.25 | 20.5M | **74.8%** |
| 0.10 | 8.3M | **89.8%** |
| 0.05 | 4.3M | **94.8%** |

关键不是省那 18k 的 L1–L4，而是**防止一次前缀破坏把 369k 的平均提示词整段打回全价**
（≈400 倍于正常一步的未命中量）。完整模型、反事实假设与边界见
[`docs/CACHE-SAVINGS.md`](docs/CACHE-SAVINGS.md)，复现：`node docs/savings-estimate.mjs`。

## 已实现的东西

| 组成 | 文件 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| L1/L3/L4 提示词段 | `src/prompt.js`、`index.js` | L1（基础规则）与 L3（角色规则）是全局静态段；L4（空间规则）按会话作用域注册，文本来自每会话快照——改空间描述不会改写已存在会话的系统节点。L2 是请求里的工具声明，不归本插件注册。 |
| 静态存储 | `src/db.js` | 用运行时自带的 `node:sqlite`（无需原生编译）：空间、会话绑定、五维记忆、FTS5 `trigram` 索引与外部内容表触发器、inbox、记忆队列、L4 快照、唤醒日志。 |
| usage 观测 | `src/observer.js`、`src/prefix.js` | 包裹 `llm/stream` waterfall，原样透传每个分块，同时为每个请求写一行 JSONL：规范化 `usage`、`wholeHit`、**双轨指标 `prefixHit` / `prefixTokens` / `prefixHitTokens`**，以及 `systemDigest` / `systemDigestAll` / `toolsDigest` / `prefixDigest`。 |
| 追加层 | `src/append.js`、`index.js` | 每个新会话注入一条 bootstrap 快照，走 `agent.inject()`：排队到下一次 `agent/pre-step`，不唤醒 Agent，也不碰已缓存前缀。 |
| 压缩接管 | `src/compaction.js`、`src/compaction-fold.js` | `compactionMode: fold` 时接管 `ctx.compaction` 并真的折叠：保留系统头、在轮次边界把较早区间替换成一条摘要（`history/replace`），失败会补写 `compaction/end` 关锁；压力到 `alarmRatio` 先落一条 `compaction/alarm`。 |
| 手动压缩工具 | `src/compact-tool.js` | `context_compact()`：只在 `fold` 模式注册，只能折叠调用者自己的会话（身份取宿主注入的 `exec.agent.id`）。 |
| 本地 embedding | `src/embedding/client.js`、`src/embedding/worker.js` | worker 线程加载 `multilingual-e5-small`（384 维，q8 ONNX），主线程只做 async RPC；首次加载约 1.7 s，单条推理中位 12.5 ms，60 条排队时主线程定时器漂移中位 3 ms。 |
| 混合检索 | `src/db-memories.js`、`src/retrieval.js` | 向量 top-20（点积=余弦）+ FTS5 trigram top-20（短查询 LIKE 兜底），RRF 融合（默认权重 **2:1**），按 token 预算截断，输出 `<memory>` 块；embedding 不可用时自动降级为关键词路。 |
| 检索工具 | `src/memory-tool.js` | `memory_search(query, limit?)`：身份取宿主注入的 `exec.agent.id`，空间归属查 `session_space_links`，模型不能指定 session/space。 |
| 记忆管理员 | `src/queue.js`、`src/memory-tools.js`、`src/prompt.js` | `memory_propose` 任何会话只入队；`memory_queue_claim` / `memory_archive` / `memory_queue_settle` / `memory_queue_stats` 仅管理员。队列原子领取、过期接管、重试上限、小时桶去重；归档本地算 embedding、校验绑定空间、取代失败整体回滚；管理员会话额外注入防注入 L3 段。 |

## 三条最容易搞混的口径

1. **`prefixDigest` 只覆盖"系统节点 0 + 工具声明"**，不是整段 L1–L4 的哈希。
   DSH 在 `systemPromptUpdate: 'in-history'` 路由上会把变化后的提示词**追加**为新的
   `system` 消息，节点 0 不变——所以还要看 `systemMessageCount`（是否变多）与
   `systemDigestAll`（有效提示词是否变了）。
2. **命中率必须双轨**：
   - `prefixHit = min(prefixTokens, cacheReadTokens) / prefixTokens` —— 架构指标（目标 ≥ 95%）。
     `prefixTokens` 用 DSH 固定启发式估算"系统节点 0 + 工具声明"；实测 17,957 里**工具占 89.8%**。
   - `wholeHit = cacheReadTokens / (inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens)` —— 只是成本参考。
   只报 `wholeHit` 会得到假数据：L5 每轮追加时它天然很高，掩盖前缀其实没被保护。
3. **缓存前提的实测状态**：TTL 已实测 **≥ 13.5 小时**（空闲 808 分钟后首请求仍命中 396,544 token）；
   **跨会话是否要求同账号仍未验证**（缺少前缀一致的两个会话做对照）。

## 安装

包根就是 bundle 根，**没有嵌套目录**。

```powershell
cd D:\dshprogram\dsh-context-array
npm install                            # 一个运行时依赖：@huggingface/transformers
node tools/fetch-model.mjs             # 下载 e5-small 到 <dataDir>/models（幂等，约 129 MiB / 3 分钟）
```

然后在 DSH 图形界面打开 **插件 → 添加插件（Plugins → Add plugin）**，选择本目录
（`D:\dshprogram\dsh-context-array`）。安装是"链接检出目录"的方式，后续改动不需要重新拷贝；
运行中的 Host 在插件行被切换或 DSH 重启后加载新代码。

> `package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向同目录 `cordis.patch.yml`，它插入一条
> `context-array` 插件行。模型可离线使用；`allowRemoteModels` 在 worker 里保持关闭，只读本地目录。

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 的配置项：

| 键 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `dataDir` | `<home>/.dsh/context-array` | SQLite 库、`usage.jsonl`、`events.jsonl`、`models/` 的根目录 |
| `spaceId` / `spaceName` / `spaceRules` | `space-default` / `Default space` / … | 首次激活时创建的单一静态空间 |
| `observeUsage` | `true` | 每个上报 usage 的请求写一行记录 |
| `bootstrapMessages` | `true` | 每个新会话注入一条 bootstrap 快照 |
| `compactionMode` | `fold` | `off` 不动部署；`observe` 只采样+告警不折叠；`fold` 接管并真折叠 |
| `compactionWarnTokens` | `300000` | 压力采样记录阈值（token） |
| `compactionAlarmRatio` | `0.7` | 压力到窗口该比例时写 `compaction/alarm` |
| `compactionFoldRatio` | `0.85` | 压力到窗口该比例才自动折叠 |
| `compactionRetainRatio` | `0.3` | 折叠后至少保留的 surface token 比例 |
| `compactionMinFoldTokens` | `8000` | 小于该 token 的区间不折叠 |
| `compactionSummaryMaxTokens` | `600` | 摘要生成的最大输出 token |
| `promptSaltFile` | `<dataDir>/prompt-salt.txt` | 诊断用：改这个文件可在观测层不停的情况下改 L1，做缓存受控实验 |
| `enableEmbedding` | `true` | 关掉则只走关键词检索（不启动 worker、不加载模型） |
| `modelsDir` | `<dataDir>/models` | 本地模型目录 |
| `adminSessionIds` | `[]` | 中央记忆管理员的会话 id（部署配置，模型不可写；M4 会有 UI 绑定） |
| `queueStaleMinutes` | `10` | 领取超过该分钟的 processing 行回到 pending |
| `queueMaxRetries` | `3` | 重试达到该值的 pending 行置 failed |

> ⚠️ `observe` 会占用 `ctx.compaction`。**如果部署里还要启用 `dsh-compaction-basic`，请先把它
> 关掉，或把本项设为 `off`**，否则两个实现者会冲突（插件会记 `compaction/provider-conflict`，
> 默认实现加载失败）。

## 验证

```powershell
node --test                              # 全仓单元 + 接线测试（122 项）
node docs/analyze-usage.mjs              # 双轨指标 + TTL 空档 + 压缩事件
node tools/seed-memories.mjs             # 往当前库塞 3 条种子记忆（幂等，用于快速试 memory_search）
node tools/eval-retrieval.mjs            # M2 检索评测（向量 / 关键词 / 混合权重对比）
Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\context-array\usage.jsonl" -Tail 3
Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\context-array\events.jsonl" -Tail 3
```

每个请求一行，字段含义见 [`docs/DETAIL.md`](docs/DETAIL.md)；`events.jsonl` 记录接管、
压力采样、告警、折叠与历史替换。工具示例：

```
memory_search("前缀缓存会不会因为改提示词失效")
→ 3 hit(s) (vector=true, keyword=true)
- [space-default/reflection] DeepSeek 前缀缓存实测很耐用：… (score 0.0164)

context_compact()
→ context_compact: folded surface nodes 12–50 (6855 estimated tokens) into one summary;
  kept the most recent 12 nodes. compactionId=9069fee1-…            # 仅 fold 模式
```

## 实测结果（整段口径，样本 = 2 个会话 / 98 条请求）

| 会话 | 请求数 | 不同 `prefixDigest` | 命中率 min / mean / max | 累计命中 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 长历史会话 | 49 | **1** | 0.9933 / **0.9986** / 0.9996 | 99.86%（17,932,672 / 24,523） |
| 冷启动会话 | 49 | **1** | 0 / 0.9534 / 0.9987 | 97.92% |

`prefixDigest` 每个会话全程只有 1 个值，说明**节点 0 + 工具声明确实逐字节不变**，
这是前缀可复用的证据；命中率数字本身**不能**当作架构验收（见上面第 2 条）。

实测还暴露并修掉了两个真缺陷：

1. **安装前已存活的会话收不到 `agent/created`**，因此拿不到 L4、也收不到 bootstrap。
   修复：激活时遍历 `ctx.get('agents')?.list()` 补做一次。
2. **agent 作用域的段注册不随插件卸载撤销**（禁用插件后 L4 仍残留在提示词里）。
   修复：把每个 L4 段的 disposer 收进插件 fiber 的 `ctx.effect`，并监听 `agent/disposed`。

## 已知边界

- 插件只能拿到适配器折算后的规范化 `TokenUsage`，**原始 provider usage JSON 不可达**；
  记录以 `usageSource: "normalized-usage-chunk"` 标注。
- **压缩折叠已实装，代价是已知的**：折叠把较早区间替换成一条摘要，替换点之后的缓存会失效一次，
  之后重新建立。折叠只在轮次边界、保留系统头、保留 ≥30% 尾部时发生；`foldRatio 0.85` 意味着
  长会话到 85% 窗口才折一次。参数未经多轮标定（见设计文档 §7）。
- **检索是"按需调用"而不是"每轮自动注入"**：`memory_search` 工具已可用，但自动把 `<memory>`
  块追加到 L5 要等 M3 有真实记忆后再做，否则每轮注入低价值内容反而稀释上下文。
- **依赖从零变为一个**：`@huggingface/transformers` + onnxruntime，`node_modules` 约 463 MiB，
  模型 129 MiB 需单独下载（`tools/fetch-model.mjs`）。瘦身方案（省 ~158 MB）未实施。
- 双轨指标只有 **8 个样本**（同一会话新代码加载后），`prefixTokens` 是字符启发式估算而非 provider 真值。
- 样本不是规模验证；跨会话同账号复用、压缩折叠成本均未测。
- 记忆管理员与留言箱属于 M3/M4：**M3 已实现**（见 `docs/M3-RESULTS.md`），留言箱与多空间 UI 属 M4。
- 管理员资格目前靠 `adminSessionIds` 配置或 `session_space_links.role='admin'`；没有后台自动轮询，
  `memory_queue_claim` 是按需调用的工具（是否常驻管理员见设计文档 §7）。

# @lukstei/dsh-client-favicon ## Summary Draws the browser tab favicon as an eight-tick status ring. Green ticks show running sessions, orange ticks show sessions awaiting review, and a centre pip shows pending interactions. For anyone running several DSH sessions in one tab. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package Mount it in the bundle patch ([cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml)): ```yaml - insert: - id: favicon name: '@lukstei/dsh-client-favicon' ``` No config. Client plugin (`platform: web`, `immediately: true`). It needs `sessions` and `uiSession`, from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session`. It needs no notification or audio permission. | Signal | Source | Rendering | |---|---|---| | Running | `sessionStatus.running`, else `sessions.list` summary `running` | Green ticks, filled from the bottom | | Review | `faviconBadge.setBadge({ reviewCount })` | Orange ticks, filled from the top | | Pending interaction | `sessionStatus.pendingInteraction` | Red centre pip | | Review overflow | `reviewCount` larger than the free ticks | Orange centre pip (the red pip wins) | - The ring has 8 ticks. Running ticks take priority; review fills the remaining ticks. Counts are not drawn as numbers. - Sessions are the union of ids in the session list and the status store, so subagents count. - With no running session, no pending interaction and `reviewCount` 0, the original favicon is restored. - If the page has `link[rel~='icon']` elements, their `href` is replaced. Otherwise one `` is created. Disposal restores the original hrefs and removes the created link. Other client plugins can inject `faviconBadge` (`IFaviconBadge`, from `@lukstei/dsh-client-favicon/client-contract`) and call `setBadge({ reviewCount })`. Reset it to 0 when the caller unloads. [`@lukstei/dsh-client-kanban`](../dsh-client-kanban/README.md) does this with its review lane count. ### Plugin dependencies Client-side only (`dsh.client`, no host entry). Client `inject`: `sessions`, `uiSession` (all required; the client plugin stays pending without them). | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `sessions` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `uiSession` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | Provides the client service `faviconBadge`. Used by: [`dsh-client-kanban`](../dsh-client-kanban/README.md) (optional `faviconBadge` consumer; its review count only reaches the favicon when this is mounted). ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand | File | Role | |---|---| | [src/index.ts](src/index.ts) | Host entry, a no-op `apply` | | [src/client/index.tsx](src/client/index.tsx) | Client entry: subscribes to the session list and status store, swaps favicon hrefs, provides `faviconBadge` | | [src/client/favicon.ts](src/client/favicon.ts) | Pure `generateFaviconSvg` / `renderFaviconBadgeUri` (SVG data URI) | | [src/client/contract.ts](src/client/contract.ts) | `IFaviconBadge` and the `Context.faviconBadge` augmentation | The renderer takes `{ running, review, alert }`. Tick order is clockwise from north: running fills S, SW, SE, W, E, NW, NE, N; review fills N, NW, NE, W, E, SW, SE, S. Inputs are floored and clamped at 0. It never throws. Persisted state: none. The effect re-renders on every session-list and status-store change.
----- ## Further Exploration - Upstream: [DSH module graph](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/module-graph.md). - [`@lukstei/dsh-client-kanban`](../dsh-client-kanban/README.md): supplies the review count. - [`@lukstei/dsh-client-notify`](../dsh-client-notify/README.md): app-icon badge and desktop notifications. ## Model Experience No model-visible surface. This package adds no tools, prompt text, or context to the model. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - Browsers differ in whether they show dynamic SVG tab favicons. Mobile launch icons and pinned tabs follow browser-specific behavior. - An existing `link[rel~='icon']` is overwritten in place; with several icon links, all get the same SVG. ### Dev Note
Working context for maintainers — click to expand `pnpm run verify` runs Biome, build, typecheck and tests ([tests/favicon.spec.ts](tests/favicon.spec.ts) for the renderer, [tests/lifecycle.spec.ts](tests/lifecycle.spec.ts) for restore/dispose).
# dsh-plugins Plugins and client extensions for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH), published as `@lukstei/*` packages. Plugin versions follow the DSH release they target: `.`, for example `0.2.3-alpha.2.1` targets DSH `0.2.3-alpha.2`. ## Install a plugin ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:lukstei/dsh-plugins#path:packages/ ``` ## Packages | Package | Description | | --- | --- | | [`@lukstei/dsh-client-favicon`](packages/dsh-client-favicon/README.md) | Browser favicon status badges for DeepSeek Harness | | [`@lukstei/dsh-client-kanban`](packages/dsh-client-kanban/README.md) | Multi-session vertical Kanban board plugin for DeepSeek Harness with native host persistence | | [`@lukstei/dsh-client-notify`](packages/dsh-client-notify/README.md) | Client-side browser desktop notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness | | [`@lukstei/dsh-client-pwa`](packages/dsh-client-pwa/README.md) | Progressive Web App assets and reverse proxy authentication for DSH | | [`@lukstei/dsh-client-review-git`](packages/dsh-client-review-git/README.md) | Git diff and GitButler change view client plugin for DeepSeek Harness | | [`@lukstei/dsh-client-split-view`](packages/dsh-client-split-view/README.md) | Concurrent multi-session split view and overlay layout plugin for DeepSeek Harness | | [`@lukstei/dsh-debug`](packages/dsh-debug/README.md) | Debug commands and transcript tools for DSH | | [`@lukstei/dsh-log`](packages/dsh-log/README.md) | File logging exporter for DSH | | [`@lukstei/dsh-resilient-persistence`](packages/dsh-resilient-persistence/README.md) | Corrupt session protection for DSH session persistence | | [`@lukstei/dsh-schedule-script`](packages/dsh-schedule-script/README.md) | Background script executor and prompt loop for DSH | | [`@lukstei/dsh-scratch-dir`](packages/dsh-scratch-dir/README.md) | Scratch directory provisioner for DSH sessions | | [`@lukstei/dsh-session-handoff`](packages/dsh-session-handoff/README.md) | Session handoff brief command for DSH | | [`@lukstei/dsh-yaml-workflow`](packages/dsh-yaml-workflow/README.md) | Execute sequential prompt workflows from YAML | | [`@lukstei/util-review-ui`](packages/util-review-ui/README.md) | Shared review UI components, types and styles for DSH review and split-view plugins | ## Development ```sh pnpm install pnpm run verify ``` The packages live in [`packages/`](packages/). This repository is generated from a private monorepo; history starts at the first release. ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

# @lukstei/dsh-client-kanban ## Summary A Kanban board for DSH sessions with four lanes: To Do, Active, Review, Done. It replaces the workspace list in the sidebar when switched on, and is also a main panel. Lane state is derived from session events, so it survives reloads without browser storage. It also gives the agent a tool to attach links to a session. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package ```yaml - insert: - id: kanban name: '@lukstei/dsh-client-kanban' config: kanban_add_link_tool_enabled: true kanban_add_link_tool_instructions: 'Collect task tickets and pull requests. Use concise labels.' ``` Host entry (`inject`: `commands`, `sessionProjections`, `tools`) registers the `kanban` session projection, the `/kanban` command, the optional `kanban_add_link` tool and scoped search. The client entry (`platform: web`, `immediately: true`) needs `slots`, `uiWorkspace`, `sessions`, `workspaces`, `uiSession`, `layout`, `remote`. | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `kanban_add_link_tool_enabled` | `true` | Register `kanban_add_link`. `false` stops advertising it; existing links stay visible | | `kanban_add_link_tool_instructions` | See [Model Experience](#model-experience) | Guidance appended to the tool description | ### Plugin dependencies Server-side and client-side entries. **Server-side** (`inject`: `commands`, `sessionProjections`, `tools`): | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `commands` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No `/kanban` command. | | `sessionProjections` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No board state. | | `tools` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No `kanban_add_link` tool. | | `sessionQuery`, `remoteAccess`, `typert` (child plugin `KanbanSearch`) | Required for search only | @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query (+ a backend such as `session-query-sqlite`), @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remote-access, @deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-registry | `KanbanSearch` is mounted with `ctx.plugin(KanbanSearch)` and not awaited: it stays pending and board search is unavailable. # @lukstei/dsh-client-notify ## Summary Alerts you when an agent stops or needs input. It shows a desktop notification, plays a short synthesized chime, and sets the installed PWA's app-icon badge. For anyone who leaves the DSH tab in the background. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package ```yaml - insert: - id: client-notify name: '@lukstei/dsh-client-notify' ``` No config. The package has a host part and a client part: - Host (`inject: webServer`): serves the Service Worker script at `/sw.js` and `/tsctl/sw.js` with `service-worker-allowed: /` and `cache-control: no-cache`. - Client (`platform: web`, `immediately: true`): needs `remote`, `remote.session`, `sessions`, `uiSession`. ### Plugin dependencies Server-side and client-side entries. **Server-side** (`inject: webServer`): | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `webServer` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver | Plugin stays pending; never applies. `/sw.js` and `/tsctl/sw.js` are not served, so the Service Worker cannot register. | **Client-side** (`inject`: `remote`, `remote.session`, `sessions`, `uiSession`): | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `remote`, `remote.session` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes / @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No notifications. | | `sessions`, `uiSession` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | Provides the client service `appBadge`. Used by: [`dsh-client-kanban`](../dsh-client-kanban/README.md) (optional `appBadge` consumer). ### Triggers | Event | Notification text | Sound | |---|---|---| | Session stops running | `Agent stopped` | pop chime | | Pending approval (`approval` kind, `acp-permission:` key, or an approval question) | `Tool approval requested: ` | alert chime | | Pending question | `Question: ` | alert chime | | Any other pending interaction kind except `plan-review` | `Action required: ` | alert chime | Rules: - Stop notifications are debounced by 3 s. A session that starts running again inside that window stays silent, so workflow steps and chained turns do not alert. - A stop notifies only if the session appended a `user/message` or `assistant/message` within the last 60 s. Runs that append no chat message (command-driven work) stay silent. A failed events read fails open and notifies. - A session with running subagents does not notify. When the last subagent stops, the parent is checked with the same debounce. - Interactions from subagent sessions never notify. Each interaction key notifies once. - On desktop, nothing is shown while the tab has focus and is visible (`document.hasFocus() && !document.hidden`). The chime still plays. On touch devices (`pointer: coarse` or `maxTouchPoints > 0`) this check is skipped. - A notification needs `Notification.permission === 'granted'`. The chime plays regardless. ### Permission and Service Worker On start the client registers `/sw.js` (scope `/`, falling back to `sw.js`). If notification permission is `default`, it requests permission on the first `click`, `touchend` or `keydown`. Notifications go through the Service Worker registration (`showNotification`) when one is ready within 300 ms, else `new Notification()`. Clicking a notification focuses an existing DSH window or opens `/`. ### App icon badge The badge (`navigator.setAppBadge`) shows sessions with a pending interaction plus recent review sessions. It is cleared at 0 and on unload. [`@lukstei/dsh-client-kanban`](../dsh-client-kanban/README.md) supplies the review part through `appBadge.setRecentReviewCount(n)` (`IAppBadge`, from `@lukstei/dsh-client-notify/client-contract`). Without Kanban the badge counts pending interactions only. The browser rejects the call when the app is not installed or permission is missing; the error is ignored. iOS shows the badge only after notification permission is granted. ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand | File | Role | |---|---| | [src/index.ts](src/index.ts) | Host: `SERVICE_WORKER_SCRIPT` and the two exact routes | | [src/client/index.ts](src/client/index.ts) | Client: stop debounce, interaction watcher, `appBadge` provider | | [src/client/notify.ts](src/client/notify.ts) | Service Worker registration, permission lifecycle, notification display | | [src/client/sound.ts](src/client/sound.ts) | Web Audio chimes | | [src/client/badge.ts](src/client/badge.ts) | `syncAppBadge` | | [src/client/contract.ts](src/client/contract.ts) | `IAppBadge` and the `Context.appBadge` augmentation | Chimes are sine oscillators, no audio files. The pop chime is 791 Hz with a fast pitch drop and about 70 ms decay. The alert chime is 587.33 Hz then 880 Hz, 120 ms apart. One `AudioContext` is created lazily, reused, and resumed when suspended. Audio errors are swallowed. Stop detection listens to `api-session/status` on `remote`. Pending interactions come from `uiSession.sessionStatus`. Notification icon is `/favicon.svg`. The Service Worker script handles `install` (`skipWaiting`), `activate` (`clients.claim`) and `notificationclick`. Persisted state: none.
----- ## Further Exploration - Upstream: [DSH module graph](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/module-graph.md). - [`@lukstei/dsh-client-pwa`](../dsh-client-pwa/README.md): PWA manifest and icons for installed-app badges. - [`@lukstei/dsh-client-favicon`](../dsh-client-favicon/README.md): tab favicon status. ## Model Experience No model-visible surface. This package adds no tools, prompt text, or context to the model. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - The Service Worker routes are fixed to `/sw.js` and `/tsctl/sw.js`. Other reverse-proxy prefixes are not served. - Notification permission needs a user gesture, so no notification is shown before the first click, tap or key press. - `plan-review` interactions do not notify. ### Dev Note
Working context for maintainers — click to expand `pnpm run verify` runs Biome, build, typecheck and tests (specs live beside the sources in `src/`).

# @lukstei/dsh-client-pwa ## Summary Makes DSH installable as a PWA and lets trusted reverse-proxy requests log in without a token. It serves the web manifest and icons, injects the manifest links into the index page, and wraps the connection's index authorization with header and IP trust checks. For deployments behind Tailscale or another authenticating proxy. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package Host plugin. Requires `webServer` and `connection`. Mount (this is the bundle patch, [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml)): ```yaml - insert: - id: client-pwa name: '@lukstei/dsh-client-pwa' config: auth: userHeader: 'tailscale-user-login' trustedCidrs: ['127.0.0.1', '::1', '100.64.0.0/10', 'fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48'] authRoutes: ['/login', '/auth/tailscale', '/auto-login'] loginRedirectPath: '/login' pwa: pathPrefixes: ['/tsctl'] ``` ### Config: `auth` | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `userHeader` | none | Request header carrying the verified user (e.g. `tailscale-user-login`, `x-forwarded-user`, `remote-user`) | | `allowedUsers` | none | If non-empty, only these users are trusted | | `trustedCidrs` | none | Trusted IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDR blocks | | `authRoutes` | `['/login']` | Route paths that perform the token exchange | | `loginRedirectPath` | `/login` | Where trusted but unauthenticated index requests are sent | | `secureCookies` | `true` | Append `; Secure` to `Set-Cookie` when `x-forwarded-proto: https` | ### Config: `pwa` | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `name` | `DeepSeek Harness` | Manifest `name` | | `shortName` | `DSH` | Manifest `short_name` | | `themeColor` | `#1f2430` | Manifest `theme_color` | | `backgroundColor` | `#0f172a` | Manifest `background_color` | | `startUrl` | `/login` | Manifest `start_url` | | `scope` | `/` | Manifest `scope` | | `display` | `standalone` | Manifest `display` | | `pathPrefixes` | none | Extra prefixes (e.g. `/tsctl`) where routes are also mounted; the root mount always exists | ### Plugin dependencies Server-side only (no client entry). `inject`: `webServer`, `connection`. | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `webServer` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No manifest, icons, or head injection. | | `connection` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection | Plugin stays pending; never applies. Its `authorizeIndex`/`admit` wrapper (reverse-proxy login) is not installed. | Non-plugin requirement: a reverse proxy that sets the configured `auth.userHeader` and connects from `auth.trustedCidrs`; otherwise trusted login never fires. The package patch carries Tailscale defaults. Used by: nothing. ### Behavior - Routes per prefix: `/manifest.webmanifest` (`no-store`), `/icons/{180,192,512}.png` (`max-age=86400`, 404 for other sizes), and each auth route as a prefix route. Auth routes without a leading `/` get one. - The index HTML gets `` and `` (an existing manifest link is replaced). The injected links use root paths, not prefixed ones. - Trust check (`isTrustedRequest`): if `userHeader` is set and present, the user must be in `allowedUsers` when that list is non-empty. If the header is missing and `allowedUsers` is non-empty, the request is untrusted. Otherwise the client IP must match `trustedCidrs`. The IP is the first `x-forwarded-for` entry, else the socket address (the socket address is passed on auth routes only). - Auth route: 400 without `Host`, 403 if untrusted, else 303 to `connection.authenticatedUrl(https://)` with `cache-control: no-store` and `referrer-policy: no-referrer`. - Index request without a `token` query param that the connection rejects: if the request is trusted, answer 200 with a small HTML page that does `location.replace(loginRedirectPath)`. Otherwise the original authorization runs. - The wrap of `connection.authorizeIndex` is restored on dispose. ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand | File | Role | |---|---| | [src/index.ts](src/index.ts) | Schemas (`Config`, `AuthConfig`, `PwaConfig`), trust helpers, `wrapAuthorizeIndex`, `handleAuthRedirect`, route registration | | [src/pwa.ts](src/pwa.ts) | `DEFAULT_PWA_OPTIONS`, `pwaManifest`, `injectPwaHead`, `handleIconRequest` | | [src/icons.ts](src/icons.ts) | Embedded base64 PNG icons for 180, 192, 512 | `normalizePrefixes` trims slashes, drops empties and always includes `""`. `isIpInCidrs` uses `node:net` `BlockList`; it strips an IPv6 zone and `::ffff:` mapping, and skips invalid entries. Manifest icons: `/favicon.svg` (any), `/icons/192.png` and `/icons/512.png` (any maskable), served from the root paths. Persisted state: none. Trust boundary: the user header and `x-forwarded-for` are trusted as sent, so the proxy in front must set or strip them. Tests: [src/index.test.ts](src/index.test.ts), [src/pwa.test.ts](src/pwa.test.ts) (`node --test`).
----- ## Further Exploration - Upstream: [DSH module graph](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/module-graph.md). - [`@lukstei/dsh-client-notify`](../dsh-client-notify/README.md): Service Worker, notifications and app-icon badge. ## Model Experience No model-visible surface. This package adds no tools, prompt text, or context to the model. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - The index bounce checks the user header and `x-forwarded-for` only. It does not pass the socket address, so CIDR trust at the index needs a proxy that sets `x-forwarded-for`. - Injected manifest and touch-icon links always use root paths. - The auth redirect always targets `https://`. - Headers are trusted without signature; deploy only behind a proxy that controls them. ### Dev Note
Working context for maintainers — click to expand `pnpm run verify` runs Biome, typecheck and `node --test`. There is no build step; `main` points at `src/index.ts`.

# @lukstei/dsh-client-review-git ## Summary Read-only Git review for DSH sessions. A Workspace Review sidebar tab and a split-pane overlay compare branches, single commits, and staged or unstaged changes in the repositories a session touched. The agent can post a review card into the chat with `git_review_present`. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-client-git-diff name: '@lukstei/dsh-client-review-git' config: {} ``` No config. Host entry `inject`: `sessionController`, `workingDirectory`, `sessions`, `sessionPersistence`; the tool part also needs `tools` and `agents`. Client (`platform: web`, `immediately: true`) needs `sidebarRightTabs`, `slots`, `remote`, `uiConversation`. It mounts the typed, session-addressed `workspaceReview` Remote (methods `catalog`, `resolve`, `commits`, `view`, `file`). Reload host and client together after an upgrade. ### Plugin dependencies Server-side and client-side entries. Patch row id: `dsh-client-git-diff`. **Server-side** (`inject`: `sessionController`, `workingDirectory`, `sessions`, `sessionPersistence`; child plugin for the tool injects `tools`, `agents`): | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `sessionController` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No `workspaceReview` Remote service and no `git_review_present` tool. | | `workingDirectory` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-working-directory | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `sessions` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-session | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `sessionPersistence` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `tools`, `agents` | Required for the tool | @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools, @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent | Child plugin stays pending: `git_review_present` not registered; the Remote service still runs. | **Client-side** (`inject`: `sidebarRightTabs`, `slots`, `remote`, `uiConversation`): | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `sidebarRightTabs`, `slots`, `remote`, `uiConversation` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots, @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation (also `-chat` in `dsh.client.inject`) | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No review UI. | | `splitView` + `remote.workspaceReview` | Optional | [`@lukstei/dsh-client-split-view`](../dsh-client-split-view/README.md); `workspaceReview` is this package's host service | Nested plugin stays pending: review cards cannot open the split-pane overlay (`opener` stays unset) and the pane-header review action is not registered. | Code imports (no mount): [`@lukstei/util-review-ui`](../util-review-ui/README.md) (`review`, `types`, client components). Declared deps `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present` are libraries; no `present` service is injected. Used by: nothing. ### UI - **Workspace Review** tab in the right sidebar (id `dsh-client-git-diff`), plus the `gitdiff.review` slot factory used by split-view overlays. - With [`@lukstei/dsh-client-split-view`](../dsh-client-split-view/README.md), a sub-plugin adds a header button (`split.pane.header.actions`) that toggles the `gitdiff.review` overlay on that pane's session. - The toolbar offers a repository dropdown when the session touched several repositories (a static label for one), then scopes: **Branches** (default **All commits**, with a separate commit dropdown) and **Working tree** (**Staged**, **Unstaged**). - One file tree combines navigation and contents. Files start collapsed; click to expand inline. Rows show addition and deletion counts. File contents load on expansion and are cached until refresh. - Selecting code offers a quote that is inserted into the conversation composer (clipboard copy when no composer is available). - View state (repository, scope, expanded files, scroll, wrap) is kept per session in `localStorage` (`dsh-client-review-git:state:v1:`) for 24 hours. ### Scopes - **Branch vs baseline.** Ordinary Git branches compare against the merge base with the remote's recorded default branch. Without exactly one `refs/remotes/*/HEAD` target, pick a baseline manually. GitButler-managed branches compare against the branch directly below them; bottom and standalone branches use `but --json config target`. A GitButler failure is shown without blocking plain Git comparisons. - When GitButler inspection succeeds, `gitbutler/workspace`, `gitbutler/target` and `main` are hidden from the branch list but stay available as baselines. Branches without a commit in the last 7 days are not offered. - **Commit.** Compares a commit with its first parent; a root commit shows its initial files. History loads 50 entries at a time. - **Staged** compares HEAD with the index (including before the first commit). **Unstaged** compares the index with the working tree and includes non-ignored untracked files as additions. Both cover the current checkout, including a GitButler workspace. - Git supplies changed-file metadata and counts. Hunks are computed client-side from both complete files, so expanding context needs no further reads. Binary or non-UTF-8 files and unresolved conflicts show a notice. - Refresh reloads the repository and branch list. Reads never check out, fetch, or change Git state. ### Repository discovery The session's current directory repository is always included. Further repositories come from files written or edited through the native `write`/`edit` tools (including calls via `run_code`) after the last working-directory change, with no file-count limit. Directory lookups are memoized. Refresh retries discovery. Shell edits and tools without path metadata are not discovered. A request for a repository outside this list is rejected. ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand | File | Role | |---|---| | [src/index.ts](src/index.ts) | Host entry: mounts `WorkspaceReviewService`, registers the tool, persists presented cards | | [src/review-tool.ts](src/review-tool.ts) | `createGitReviewTool` (`git_review_present`) | | [src/workspace-review-service.ts](src/workspace-review-service.ts) | `workspaceReview` Remote: session repository discovery and methods | | [src/git-service.ts](src/git-service.ts) | `git` and `but` calls: repositories, scopes, commits, compare, file contents | | [src/client/index.tsx](src/client/index.tsx) | Client entry: sidebar tab, slot factory, card slots, split sub-plugin | | [src/client/contract.ts](src/client/contract.ts) | `gitdiff.review` factory and `tool.call.toolview` slot augmentations | | [src/client/review-turn.ts](src/client/review-turn.ts) | Turn data node `git-review`, built from `command/run` events | | `src/client/GitDiffPane.tsx`, `ReviewToolbar.tsx`, `FileInspector.tsx`, `GitReviewCard.tsx`, `GitReviewRow.tsx`, `useReviewViewState.ts` | UI and view state | | [scripts/gen-typert.ts](scripts/gen-typert.ts) | Generates `lib/typert.host.*` and `lib/typert.remote-client.*` (`pnpm run gen:typert`, part of build/typecheck) | On a successful `git_review_present` result the host appends a `command/run` (`git-review`, args `{ turn, callId, target }`) and a `command/done` event to the session. The client rebuilds cards from those events, so reloads and replays show the same cards. Review scope resolution is deferred to click time through `workspaceReview.resolve`. Cards render in `conversation.chat.turnTail`; the tool call row renders in `tool.call.toolview`. Shared components and schemas come from [`@lukstei/util-review-ui`](../util-review-ui/README.md). Trust boundary: every Remote call is session-scoped and `repository` must be in the session's discovered list; git and `but` run as read-only commands. Tests: unit specs beside sources; integration specs in [src/integration/](src/integration/) (`pnpm run test:integration`).
----- ## Further Exploration - Upstream: [DSH module graph](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/module-graph.md). - [`@lukstei/util-review-ui`](../util-review-ui/README.md), [`@lukstei/dsh-client-split-view`](../dsh-client-split-view/README.md). ## Model Experience ### git_review_present #### What the model sees Description: "Present a Git review card in the transcript. Always use it instead of writing the branch and commit into the reply when the user should inspect them." Parameters: `repository` (optional absolute path, or path relative to the session working directory, to a file or directory inside the repo; defaults to the working directory), `branch` (required, local branch name or full ref), `commit` (optional SHA or ref on `branch`; reviews that commit alone). Result text: `Git review ready: @ ()`, the commit and repo parts only when present. #### Token effect One tool schema per mounted agent and one short result line per call. #### KV Cache effect The schema is static for the mount lifetime. Results extend the conversation without rewriting its prefix. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - The review card's open button needs Split View. Without it the call succeeds and the card shows, but it has no open action. - Repository discovery ignores shell edits and tools without file path metadata. - GitButler support relies on the `but` CLI being on the host `PATH`. ### Dev Note
Working context for maintainers — click to expand `pnpm run verify` runs Biome, typert generation and build, typecheck, unit and integration tests. `pnpm run ladle` serves component stories.

# @lukstei/dsh-client-split-view ## Summary Replaces the single-session chat view with side-by-side session panes. Each pane can show a file, a plugin view, or a related session in an overlay. Open panes persist across reloads. Used directly by people running several sessions at once, and by the Kanban and Git review plugins through the `splitView` service. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package ```yaml - insert: - id: split-view name: '@lukstei/dsh-client-split-view' ``` No config. Client plugin (`platform: web`, `immediately: true`). Required services: `slots`, `sessions`, `uiWorkspace`, `uiSession`, `layout`, `remote`, `sidebarRight`, `remote.workspaceFiles`. The host entry is a no-op. ### Plugin dependencies Client-side only. Client `inject`: `slots`, `sessions`, `uiWorkspace`, `uiSession`, `layout`, `remote`, `sidebarRight`, `remote.workspaceFiles`. | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `slots` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `sessions` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `uiWorkspace`, `uiSession`, `layout` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `remote`, `remote.workspaceFiles` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway, @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-workspace-files | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `sidebarRight` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | Code import (no mount): [`@lukstei/util-review-ui`](../util-review-ui/README.md) (`quote`, `useSelectionQuote`). Provides the client service `splitView`. Used by: [`dsh-client-kanban`](../dsh-client-kanban/README.md) (optional), [`dsh-client-review-git`](../dsh-client-review-git/README.md) (optional), [`dsh-session-handoff`](../dsh-session-handoff/README.md) (required, client side). ### Behavior - Open sessions are equal-width columns. Focus, maximize or close each one; double-clicking a pane header (outside buttons) toggles maximize. Headers are draggable to reorder panes. - Viewports under 768 px show one pane. Selecting a session replaces the current one, and maximize is disabled. - State (open sessions, focus, overlays) is stored in `localStorage` under `dsh-client-split-view:state:v1` and restored once the session list is `ready`. - A header control in `conversation.session.header.utilities` (`split-view-restore`) restores the split from the native view. - While a pane is the pointer origin, `uiWorkspace.openSession` opens the target in that pane as a `session` overlay. `sidebarRight.openResource` opens a `file` overlay for file addresses; `uiWorkspace.startSession` creates a session and adds it as a pane. Other cases fall through to the originals. The overrides are restored on dispose. - File overlays preview Markdown (rendered), images (png, jpg, gif, webp, avif, bmp, svg) or plain text. ### Service: `splitView` `ISplitView` (from `@lukstei/dsh-client-split-view/client-contract`), provided on the Cordis client context: | Member | Purpose | |---|---| | `getSnapshot`, `subscribe` | Observe `SplitState` (`sessionIds`, `focusedSessionId`, `maximizedSessionId`, `hoveredSessionId`, `suspended`, `overlays`) | | `openSession`, `toggleSession`, `removeSession`, `resetToSingle` | Pane membership | | `setFocus`, `toggleMaximize`, `setHoveredSession`, `reorderSession` | Pane state | | `suspend`, `resume`, `isSuspended`, `isSplitActive` | Switch between split and native view | | `openSlotOverlay(hostId, slotName, title, props)`, `closeOverlay(hostId)` | Factory overlays | | `setFallbackPanelId(id)` | Panel selected when the last pane closes; default `null` (native conversation). Integrations must restore `null` on disposal | `openSlotOverlay` props must be JSON objects (pass `{}` for factories without input). Functions, cycles, class instances and non-finite numbers are rejected before the current overlay is replaced. Props persist and are restored on reload. The overlay tab stays closable if its factory provider unloads. ### Slots | Slot | Kind | Purpose | |---|---|---| | `split.pane` | single, session | Conversation viewport per column | | `split.overlay` | single, session | File, factory and child-session overlays | | `split.pane.status` | single, session | Pane indicator | | `split.subagent.status` | single, session | Subagent indicator (owner state `active` or `review`) | | `split.pane.header.actions` | list, session | Plugin header actions; register through `ctx.slots.inject` | CSS classes use `dsh-split-*`; pane roots carry `data-split-pane`. ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand | File | Role | |---|---| | [src/index.ts](src/index.ts) | Host no-op | | [src/client/index.tsx](src/client/index.tsx) | Client entry: provides `splitView`, registers `main` / slots, hydration, navigation overrides, restore control. Re-exports `SplitStore`, `splitStore`, `ISplitView`, `SplitOverlay`, `SplitState` | | [src/client/contract.ts](src/client/contract.ts) | Public types and Cordis/slot augmentations | | [src/client/split-store.ts](src/client/split-store.ts) | `SplitStore`: membership, overlays, persistence, mobile rules | | [src/client/SplitLayout.tsx](src/client/SplitLayout.tsx), [SplitPane.tsx](src/client/SplitPane.tsx), [SplitPaneHeader.tsx](src/client/SplitPaneHeader.tsx) | UI | | [src/client/file-preview.ts](src/client/file-preview.ts) | Path to preview kind (`markdown`, `image`, `text`) | | [src/client/styles.ts](src/client/styles.ts) | Stylesheet registration | Each pane holds a `SessionReference` (source `splitView`) released on removal. The main view registers with key `split-view`; the registration precedes hydration because a re-applied fiber can restore a ready list synchronously. A pointer or focus interaction outside every pane (menus and dialogs excepted) clears the pointer origin. Persisted: `localStorage` only. File overlays store address, owner session, path and title; loaded `contents` are not stored. Session overlays store target and title. Tests: [tests/](tests/) (store, layout, overlays, header, hydration, styles).
----- ## Further Exploration - Upstream: [DSH module graph](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/module-graph.md). - [`@lukstei/dsh-client-kanban`](../dsh-client-kanban/README.md): uses `splitView` for navigation and status. - [`@lukstei/dsh-client-review-git`](../dsh-client-review-git/README.md): adds a header action and overlay. ## Model Experience No model-visible surface. This package adds no tools, prompt text, or context to the model. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - The mobile threshold (768 px) is fixed. - Split state is per browser (`localStorage`), not per user or host. - No Review or Kanban dependency exists in this package; those plugins plug in through the service and slots. ### Dev Note
Working context for maintainers — click to expand `pnpm run verify` runs Biome, build, typecheck and tests.

# @lukstei/dsh-debug ## Summary Adds two slash commands that copy the current session's transcript or ID to the clipboard. Use them to attach a session to a bug report. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package Mount through the bundle patch ([`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)): ```yaml - insert: - id: debug name: '@lukstei/dsh-debug' config: {} ``` Required service: `commands`. | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `copy` | `pbcopy` writer | Hidden, programmatic only: `(text: string) => Promise`. Not settable from YAML. | Commands: | Command | Result | |---|---| | `/copy-transcript` | Copies all events of the session's in-memory snapshot as JSON Lines. Success text: `Copied session events to clipboard`. Error `Session contains no events to copy` if empty; the clipboard is left untouched. | | `/copy-session-id` | Copies the session id. | The default clipboard writer spawns `pbcopy` and works on macOS only. Other platforms fail with `Clipboard copy is unsupported on ; expected darwin`, returned as a command error (`Failed to copy ...`). To support Linux, pass a `copy` function when mounting programmatically: ```typescript ctx.plugin(debugPlugin, { copy: async (text: string) => { // pipe to wl-copy, xclip, or a test sink }, }); ``` ### Plugin dependencies Server-side only. `inject: commands`. | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `commands` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No `/copy-transcript` or `/copy-session-id`. | Non-plugin requirement: default clipboard export spawns `pbcopy` (macOS only; other platforms reject with an error; `config.copy` replaces it). Used by: nothing. ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand Single file: [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts). Tests: [`src/index.test.js`](src/index.test.js). Exports `Config`, `serializeEventsToJsonl`, `copyToClipboard`, `apply`. - `/copy-transcript` reads `invocation.agent.session.snapshotEvents()` (live in-memory events, deprecated upstream API) and serializes one `JSON.stringify(event)` per line, trailing newline. - Handlers return `{ kind: "success" | "error", text }`; clipboard failures never throw. - `Config.copy` is `Schema.any().hidden()`: no type validation of the supplied function.
----- ## Further Exploration - Upstream: [DSH module graph](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/module-graph.md). ## Model Experience No model-visible surface. This package adds no tools, prompt text, or context to the model. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - Clipboard support is macOS only unless a custom `copy` is supplied. - The transcript is the in-memory snapshot, not the persisted log. - Uses the deprecated `snapshotEvents()`; no replacement is wired. ### Dev Note

# @lukstei/dsh-log ## Summary Routes Cordis logger output to stdout and/or log files, with per-logger severity thresholds for each destination. Use it to keep a persistent log of selected loggers. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package The shipped [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) mounts one `stdout` output with `default: 2` (INFO). Mount with file output: ```yaml - insert: - id: file-log name: '@lukstei/dsh-log' config: outputs: - target: stdout levels: { default: 2, jev-audit: -1 } - target: file filePath: ~/.dsh/cache/approvals.log levels: { default: -1, jev-audit: 2 } ``` | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `outputs` | none | Array of destinations. Each registers its own Cordis exporter. | | `outputs[].target` | required | `stdout` or `file`. | | `outputs[].filePath` | required for `file` | Log file path. `~` or `~/...` expands to the home directory. | | `outputs[].levels` | required | Map of logger name to threshold. `default` is the catch-all. | Levels: `-1` silenced, `0` ERROR, `1` WARN, `2` INFO, `3` DEBUG. A message is written when its level is at most the threshold. `default: -1` plus named loggers gives an include-list. Line format: ` [] [] `. If the host already prints logs to the console, a `stdout` output duplicates them. ### Plugin dependencies No plugin dependencies. The plugin has no `inject`; it registers `ctx.logger.exporter` on the Cordis context. Non-plugin requirement: write access to any configured `outputs[].filePath` (the file target). Used by: nothing mounts it as a dependency. ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand Single file: [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts). Tests: [`src/index.test.js`](src/index.test.js). Exports `Config`, `formatMessage`, `expandHome`, `createFileWriter`, `apply`. - `apply` loops over `outputs` and calls `ctx.logger.exporter({ colors: false, levels, export })` for each. - File writes use `appendFileSync`. The parent directory is created recursively on the first write. - Write errors are swallowed so a failing disk cannot trigger recursive logging. - Config is a schemastery union on `target`; `filePath` and `levels` are required.
----- ## Further Exploration - Upstream: [DSH module graph](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/module-graph.md). ## Model Experience No model-visible surface. This package adds no tools, prompt text, or context to the model. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - No rotation or size limit on log files. - File write failures are silent. - A configured `outputs` entry with an empty array writes nothing. ### Dev Note
Working context for maintainers — click to expand None.

# @lukstei/dsh-resilient-persistence ## Summary Hides sessions with corrupt event logs from `sessionPersistence.list()` so one bad log cannot crash session listing. Mount it in any profile that has long-lived session history. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package Mount through the bundle patch ([`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)): ```yaml - insert: - id: resilient-session-persistence name: '@lukstei/dsh-resilient-persistence' config: {} ``` No config fields. Required service: `sessionPersistence`. Behavior: - Every session returned by `sessionPersistence.list()` is test-opened in `read` mode and closed again. A session whose open throws is dropped from the result. - Verified results are cached per `${sessionId}:${revision}`. A session is re-checked only when its revision changes. - A dropped session logs one warning (on first detection of that revision): ```text [resilient-persistence] Corrupt session "" omitted: ``` To remove a corrupt session for good, delete its folder under `~/.dsh/sessions/`. ### Plugin dependencies Server-side only. `inject: sessionPersistence`. | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `sessionPersistence` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No batch verification or corrupt-log filtering; upstream persistence runs unwrapped. | Used by: nothing. ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand Single file: [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts). Tests: [`src/index.test.js`](src/index.test.js). - `apply` replaces `persistence.list` inside `ctx.effect`. The original `list` is restored on dispose. - A `Symbol.for("dsh.resilientSessionPersistence.wrapped")` marker on the service makes wrapping idempotent; it is removed on dispose. - Uncached snapshots are verified in batches of 16 with `Promise.all`; `open` is the original, bound method. - Cache values are `true` (valid) or `false` (corrupt). A cached `false` is omitted silently on later lists; the warning is not repeated. - The cache lives in the `apply` closure and is never evicted. - `list` options are passed through to both the original `list` and `open`.
----- ## Further Exploration - Upstream: [DSH module graph](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/module-graph.md). ## Model Experience No model-visible surface. This package adds no tools, prompt text, or context to the model. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - Monkey patch of `sessionPersistence.list`; upstream has no soft-fail hook for corrupt logs. - Only failures at `open` are detected. A log that opens but breaks later is not filtered. - Verification opens every uncached session once, so the first list after start is slower with many sessions. - Corrupt sessions are hidden, not repaired. This includes logs written by a newer harness with unknown event types. ### Dev Note
Working context for maintainers — click to expand None.

# @lukstei/dsh-schedule-script ## Summary Runs recurring TypeScript scripts in the background without calling the model. A script polls something, keeps state between runs, and only wakes the agent when it returns a `prompt`. Agents use it through the `schedule-script` skill and two tools; users see a status button and a command card in the chat. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package Mount it in the agent's Cordis composition (also shipped as `cordis.patch.yml`): ```yaml - id: schedule-script name: '@lukstei/dsh-schedule-script' config: {} ``` The plugin has no config fields. Required services (`inject`): `commands`, `sessionProjections`, `tools`, `skills`, `schedule`. The web client bundle (`./client`) needs `slots`, `remote`, `remote.schedule`. ### Plugin dependencies Server-side and client-side entries. **Server-side** (`inject`: `commands`, `sessionProjections`, `tools`, `skills`, `schedule`): | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `commands` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `sessionProjections` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `tools` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No schedule tools. | | `skills` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill | Plugin stays pending; never applies. The `schedule-script` skill is not registered. | | `schedule` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule | Plugin stays pending; never applies. # @lukstei/dsh-scratch-dir ## Summary Creates a per-session scratch directory at `.agents/scratch/` in the session working directory and tells the agent its path through a system prompt section. Agents use it for plans, notes and throwaway files instead of the repo root. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package Mount through the bundle patch ([`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)): ```yaml - insert: - id: scratch-dir name: '@lukstei/dsh-scratch-dir' config: {} ``` No config fields. Required services: `systemPrompt`, `workingDirectory`. Behavior, on each `agent/created`: - Creates `/.agents/scratch/` (recursive). - Creates `.agents/scratch/.gitignore` containing `*` if it does not exist (`wx` flag; an existing file is left alone). Scratch files stay out of git. - Adds the system prompt section described under [Model Experience](#model-experience). - Rejects a session id that would resolve outside `.agents/scratch` (parent directory must equal the scratch root). No directory and no prompt section; a warning is logged. - Any filesystem error is logged as a warning and the agent starts without the section. Exported helper `scratchDirectory(cwd, sessionId)` returns the directory or `undefined` for an unsafe id. [`@lukstei/dsh-session-handoff`](../dsh-session-handoff/README.md) imports it. ### Plugin dependencies Server-side only. `inject`: `systemPrompt`, `workingDirectory`. | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `systemPrompt` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No prompt section. | | `workingDirectory` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-working-directory | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No directory created. | Exports `scratchDirectory()` (pure function). Used by: [`dsh-session-handoff`](../dsh-session-handoff/README.md) imports `scratchDirectory`; that is a code import, so mounting `scratch-dir` is not required. ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand Single file: [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts). Tests: [`src/index.test.ts`](src/index.test.ts). - The working directory is read with `ctx.workingDirectory.get(agent.session)` at agent creation. Later directory changes do not move the scratch directory. - The section is registered on `agent.ctx.systemPrompt` with `interpolate: false`. - Trust boundary: the session id is used as a path segment, so `scratchDirectory` checks `path.dirname(resolved) === scratchRoot`.
----- ## Further Exploration - Upstream: [DSH module graph](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/module-graph.md). ## Model Experience ### Scratch directory section #### What the model sees One system prompt section, name `lukstei-dsh-plugins:scratch-directory`, order `10300`: ```text The scratch directory is located at /.agents/scratch/. ``` #### Token effect One sentence plus an absolute path, roughly 20 tokens per agent. #### KV Cache effect The text is fixed for the agent's lifetime, so it does not invalidate the cache within a session. It contains the session id, so the prompt differs from other sessions from this section onward; content ordered after it cannot share a prefix across sessions. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - Directories are never cleaned up. - The `.gitignore` is created only once; an existing one is not checked for content. - Nothing stops the agent from writing elsewhere; the section is advisory. ### Dev Note

# @lukstei/dsh-session-handoff ## Summary Adds a `/handoff` command that turns a session log into a short resume brief. Bare `/handoff` starts a new session beside the current one with the brief loaded; `/handoff ` writes another session's brief into the current session. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package Mount through the bundle patch ([`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)) and add the package to the profile: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml - insert: - id: session-handoff name: '@lukstei/dsh-session-handoff' config: {} ``` ```json // ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@lukstei/dsh-session-handoff"] } }, "dependencies": { "@lukstei/dsh-session-handoff": "^0.1.0" } } ``` Then `pnpm install` in the profile directory and restart the harness. No config fields. Required Host services (`inject`): `commands`, `sessionQuery`, `workingDirectory`, `sessionController`, `sessionTitle`, `workspaceRegistry`. Workspace dependency: [`@lukstei/dsh-scratch-dir`](../dsh-scratch-dir/README.md) (`scratchDirectory()`). The client half needs `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` and [`@lukstei/dsh-client-split-view`](../dsh-client-split-view/README.md). Build it with `pnpm build` (emits `dist/client.js`); rebuild and restart after changing `src/client/`. The client bundle is marked `immediately` because no route lazily pulls it in; without stage-one prefetch its watcher would never register. ```text /handoff /handoff 06542298 /handoff 06542298-c989-417d-9ed4-fa5877768140 ``` ### Plugin dependencies Server-side and client-side entries. **Server-side** (`inject`: `commands`, `sessionQuery`, `workingDirectory`, `sessionController`, `sessionTitle`, `workspaceRegistry`): | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `commands` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands | Plugin stays pending; never applies. No `/handoff`. | | `sessionQuery` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `workingDirectory` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-working-directory | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `sessionController` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `sessionTitle` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-title | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `workspaceRegistry` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | **Client-side** (`inject`: `sessions`, `splitView`; both required): | Plugin / service | Required? | Provided by | Effect without it | |---|---|---|---| | `sessions` | Required | @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller | Plugin stays pending; never applies. | | `splitView` | Required | [`@lukstei/dsh-client-split-view`](../dsh-client-split-view/README.md) (also in `dsh.client.inject`) | Plugin stays pending; never applies. The client entry (launch into a pane) does not activate; the host `/handoff` command still works. | Code import (no mount): [`@lukstei/dsh-scratch-dir`](../dsh-scratch-dir/README.md) (`scratchDirectory`). Used by: nothing. ### Modes | Input | Brief describes | Brief lands in | Then | |---|---|---|---| | `/handoff` | this session | scratch directory of a newly created session | New session opens as a split pane. | | `/handoff ` | that session | `/.agents/scratch//HANDOFF.md` | Current agent is told to read it. | Id resolution: exact id first, then unique prefix over `sessionQuery.listSessions()`. Unknown ids return an error listing the 5 most recent sessions; ambiguous prefixes list candidates. Passing the current session's id is an error. Any non-id text, including `launch`, is treated as an id. A session with no turns returns an error. All I/O failures return `{ kind: "error" }`. ### Bare `/handoff` launch 1. Renders this session's brief. 2. Creates a session via `sessionController.create()` in the current workspace (falls back to `cwd` when the session has no workspace), same `agentPreset`. 3. Replays the current model selection onto the new agent. 4. Titles it ` - Handoff` (or `Handoff ` when untitled). A user title pins it against auto-generated titles. 5. Runs `/kanban {"action":"init","createdAt":…}` against the new agent so it appears on the Kanban board. No `prompt` is sent, since that would seed the composer draft with the follow-up text. 6. Writes `HANDOFF.md` into the new session's scratch directory and queues the read-the-brief follow-up. 7. Returns `Handoff launched: `. The client opens the pane. Without the client bundle the session is created but not opened. ### Brief layout | Section | Contents | | --- | --- | | Header | session id, cwd, creation time, event and turn counts | | `## Goal` | first user prompt, head 500 + tail 300 chars | | `## Turns` | one `### T [end reason]` block per turn: ask and final reply. Last 5 turns quote each 1200 head + 400 tail chars; older turns flatten to the ask (500/300) and reply (240 chars) | | `## Failures` | every `tool/result` with `isError`: turn, tool name, reason (200 chars) | | `## Artifacts` | deduped paths from tool call arguments (`path`, `file_path`, `filePath`, `notebook_path`), max 12 | Empty sections render `none`. Output is deterministic for a given log. `request/header`, `agent/inbox/spliced` and reasoning blocks are excluded. ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand Files: - [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts): command registration, target resolution, `deliver` (write brief + queue follow-up), `createBeside` (launch). - [`src/handoff.ts`](src/handoff.ts): `renderHandoff` and `handoffInstruction`, pure. - [`src/launch.ts`](src/launch.ts): `LAUNCH_PREFIX`, `formatLaunchResult`, `launchedSessionId`. - [`src/client/index.ts`](src/client/index.ts): client watcher. Tests sit beside each file. Details: - The command declares `input: { hint: "[session-id]" }`. Without a declared input the client sends the raw line to the model as a prompt and the handler never runs. - A slash command has no structured return channel to the client, so the Host encodes the new id in the command result text, which is persisted in the `command/done` event. The client subscribes to every open session's event source and calls `ctx.splitView.toggleSession()` when it sees a successful `command/done` starting with `Handoff launched: `. - The pane is added through the split store, not `uiWorkspace.openSession()`. The split view patches that method into a read-only overlay without its own composer, so prompts would keep landing in the pane underneath. - The client reacts only to `append` changes. A `replace` replays the whole window on first open and after reconnect gaps and would reopen panes the user closed; the split view restores its panes from local storage. - Kanban membership is a session-log fact: the board lists only sessions whose `kanban` projection is initialized, which happens when `/kanban` runs in that session. Hence the explicit `init`. - A session created by `cwd` alone is attached to no workspace and stays out of the sidebar tree until the next Host start, so the workspace id is used when available. - Turn attribution: `user/message` carries no turn number, so it is attributed to the most recently opened turn. - Artifact extraction parses tool arguments as JSON; non-JSON payloads are ignored. - The scratch path comes from `scratchDirectory()`; an unsafe id throws and the command returns an error. Trust boundary: the session id argument and session log contents are untrusted text; output is markdown written under the scratch directory only.
----- ## Further Exploration - [`@lukstei/dsh-scratch-dir`](../dsh-scratch-dir/README.md) — scratch path convention. - [`@lukstei/dsh-client-split-view`](../dsh-client-split-view) — pane host. - Upstream: [DSH module graph](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/module-graph.md). ## Model Experience ### /handoff #### What the model sees One queued follow-up user message in the receiving session: ```text The handoff brief for session is at /HANDOFF.md. Read that file now, then reply with three lines and stop: Goal: State: Next: Do not start the work until the user confirms the next action. ``` The model then reads `HANDOFF.md` with its own file tools. It gets no tool, system prompt section or other injected context from this package. A follow-up is used because the system prompt is fixed at the first request; `agent.followup()` writes a logged `user/message`, so the instruction is replayable and visible in the transcript. #### Token effect About 60 tokens for the message, plus the brief when read. Brief size grows with turn count (one `## Turns` block per turn, up to about 1,000 chars each for older turns; the last 5 turns are quoted longer). #### KV Cache effect Appended message only; the prompt prefix is untouched. In a launched session this is the first turn. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - Opening the new pane needs the client bundle and the split-view plugin. - The brief is a heuristic summary of the log; tool outputs, reasoning and request headers are not included. - `## Turns` size is unbounded in turn count. ### Dev Note
Working context for maintainers — click to expand None.
